title: Music Information Intelligence Team Researchers Receive Best Presentation Award
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Researchers from Music Information Intelligence Team, Masatoshi Hamanaka (Team Director), Hiroya Miura (Research Scientist), Tetsuya Komuro (Senior Visiting Scientist), and Shintaro Seki (JSPS PD Researcher), have received the Best Presentation Award from the Information Processing Society of Japan (IPSJ) Special Interest Group on Music and Computer Science. The award-winning presentation was titled “School Song Creation with Student Participation Using AI Composition Support,” authored by Masatoshi Hamanaka, Hiroya Miura, Shintaro Seki, Eita Nakamura, Hitomi Kaneko, and Tetsuya Komuro. This award is presented to researchers who deliver outstanding presentations, selected by the SIG committee based on votes cast by participants at the research meeting. Awarded Presentation: “School Song Creation with Student Participation Using AI Composition Support” Award Information: IPSJ SIG Music and Computer Science Best Presentation Award https://www.ipsj.or.jp/award/mus-award1.html (Japanese only) Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
